name: Gilles Boyer - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how the EU budget was protected from fraud in 2023. It asks the European Commission and member states to speed up recovery of misspent money, share data better, use artificial intelligence carefully to spot fraud, and fix weak national control systems. It also calls for more transparency about who finally receives EU money, especially under the pandemic recovery fund, and for Hungary to join the European Public Prosecutor's Office.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only gives its opinion and asks others to act.
- **Who it affects:** The European Commission, member states, and EU anti-fraud bodies.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states are urged to follow the recommendations.
